title: Fermionic many-body topology in cavity-coupled Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chains
summary: We study the effects of cavity-mediated interactions on the symmetries and topological properties of a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain coupled to a single mode photonic cavity. Considering an off-resonant regime we use the high-frequency expansion in order to obtain an effective fermionic Hamiltonian with cavity-mediated interactions.
